name: com.bugord.uikit
description: MVVM framework for Unity UI Toolkit: views, view models, widgets and screen navigation, with optional VContainer and Zenject integrations. Works without a DI container too.

samples.description: Screens, popups, payloads and result flows wired up end-to-end. Includes a scene that needs no DI container, plus VContainer and Zenject variants that compile only when those packages are installed. Open a scene and press Play.
